_comment: Hand-maintained by design - this is the one exception the instrument UI's design brief allows to zero-config discovery: the mapping of public hostnames to instances lives on a different host (oldmini, 192.168.36.68) entirely, in its own Caddyfile, and cannot be read from this host. Verified against oldmini:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile directly (2026-08-10) rather than guessed. Keyed by this instance's own -p port. Update this file (and only this file) if oldmini's Caddy config for these hostnames ever changes.
